Subject: Demo logistics and timezone constraints

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again — we’re ready to do a technical walkthrough next week for the BrightMart ads team. One complication: our product and ops folks are split across US West (PST) and US East (EST), while your engineering folks we want on the call are in Berlin (CET). With daylight‑savings quirks recently settled, we still have a very tight overlap window that avoids late nights for our PMs.

Can you propose concrete start times that work for a 60–75 minute session where:
- Core demo + product narrative (~40 min) includes Redwood engineers (runtime, latency examples)
- 20–30 minute Q&A for deeper tech questions

Ideal for us would be a start between 08:00–09:30 PST (16:00–18:30 CET) so our East Coast folks can join at lunch. If that can’t work, we’re open to a two-part approach (short core demo + later deep‑dive) — but would prefer a single convened session if possible.

Also: please attach a short agenda and any timezone conversion matrix so we can circulate internally.

—Jason
Jason Park

Hi Jason — great to hear, thanks for the constraints. I talked to our EU engineering leads and product folks and we have two practical patterns that keep any single participant from being on a truly late call:

Option A — single convened session (preferred):
- Start: 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET (60–75 minutes)
- Structure: 40 min demo (Redwood eng + product) + 25 min open tech Q&A
- Pros: everyone joins once, live handoffs; cons: a few US East folks join around 11:30 ET which is OK for them

Option B — split shift (staggered):
- Start: 07:30 PT / 16:30 CET — 30 min core demo with execs + product narrative (recorded)
- Follow-up deep dive: 10:30 PT / 19:30 CET — 30–45 min with EU engineers for low‑level questions (smaller audience)
- Pros: minimizes single-person late hours; cons: two short sessions and we’ll rely on the recording for overlapping attendees

I’m attaching a short agenda and a timezone matrix showing the conversions for PST/EST/CET to make approvals easier. If you prefer Option A, I can lock 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET on the calendar and add a 30‑minute buffer after for private follow-ups with your engineers. If Option B is better, we can schedule two adjacent calendar blocks.

Also: would you like us to loop in Laura Bennett (our Solutions lead) for the exec portion? She can cover pricing/capacity and shorten POQ.

Proposed next steps:
- Pick A or B (or propose a tweak)
- I’ll send an invite with a short agenda and a calendar poll for alternate slots if needed

Thanks —
